newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BRUSSELS BOURSE SAW RECORD VOLUME IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: BRUSSELS BOURSE SAW RECORD VOLUME IN 1996.

text.p: The Brussels bourse has seen record trading volume of 808.4 billion francs in 1996, an average of 3.2 billion francs per day, compared to 2.2 billion in 1995, the bourse said in a statement on Thursday.
Total market capitalistion rose 27.5 percent to a new record of 3,806 billion francs at the end of 1996.
The Bel-20 index closed the year 21.5 percent higher at 1,895.49 points.
